summary.name: Mintlify
summary.one_liner: Mintlify is a documentation platform that keeps documentation self-updating and serves it to both people and AI agents.
use_cases: Keeping product or developer documentation up to date automatically
Making company knowledge searchable for AI agents
Controlling who can access internal documentation
Connecting documentation to existing company systems
Collaborating on docs between teams and agents
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Mintlify as a self-updating documentation platform for startups, enterprises, and agents. Listed capabilities include self-updating knowledge, access control, connections to existing systems, and team and agent collaboration. It says it can be built on top of an existing setup. Usage figures shown on the page include over 10 million pages read and about 21,500 content updates, though these are presented as platform stats rather than verified measurements. The page gives no technical detail on how updates or integrations work.
notable: Self-updating documentation that keeps content current
Designed to be read and queried by AI agents as well as humans
caveats: Page gives no pricing details; freemium status comes from the directory listing, not the page itself
Most content is marketing claims and usage statistics; no technical documentation of features is shown
